title: The Glass Meridian
hook_central: A marriage of convenience to save a dying mother pulls an investigative journalist into a global conspiracy that holds the key to her own family's secret.

female.name: Lin Wei
female.voice: Observant and precise; she speaks with deliberate analysis, often questioning assumptions. Her tone can shift from professional to vulnerable when her mother is mentioned.
tics: Taps her index finger on surfaces when thinking
Checks her phone obsessively for news updates
Bites her lower lip when nervous or suspicious
female.boundary: She will never compromise her integrity as a journalist; she uses her access and cultural knowledge as weapons, and refuses to be used as a pawn without gaining an equivalent truth in return.
female.internal_voice: She frequently second-guesses motives, runs mental timelines, and suspects hidden angles in every action Adrian takes.

male.name: Adrian Vale
male.voice: Controlled, cold, and measured; he rarely raises his voice, but his words carry weight. He often uses silence as a tactic, forcing others to fill the void.
tics: Strokes his tie or cufflinks when calculating
Tilts his head slightly when studying someone
male.boundary: He is ruthless in business but refuses to cause direct harm to innocents; he lives by a code of efficiency, but guilt over his father's actions drives him to atone through control.
male.wound: His mother died in a controversial clinical trial run by the Glass Meridian; his father covered it up and signed false documents.
